python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset_chatgpt.csv'); stats = df[['area', 'price']].describe(); correlation = df['area'].corr(df['price']); print('--- Descriptive Statistics ---'); print(stats); print('\n--- Correlation ---'); print(f'Pearson Correlation between area and price: {correlation:.4f}')"

python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset_chatgpt.csv'); print('Area Outliers (> 50000):'); print(df[df['area'] > 50000][['area', 'price']]); print('\nPrice Outliers (> 50000000):'); print(df[df['price'] > 50000000][['area', 'price']])"

python3 -c "import pandas as pd; df = pd.read_csv('data/housing_dataset_chatgpt.csv'); df_cleaned = df[(df['area'] < 50000) & (df['price'] < 50000000)]; stats = df_cleaned[['area', 'price']].describe(); correlation = df_cleaned['area'].corr(df_cleaned['price']); print('--- Statistics (Cleaned) ---'); print(stats); print('\n--- Correlation (Cleaned) ---'); print(f'Pearson Correlation between area and price: {correlation:.4f}')"
